{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''rebellion''' was organized by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on<ref name="UB1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Weldii system/Legends|Weldii system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Weldii III]]<ref name="UB1" /> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date 3.5 ABY">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished2|text=Unfinished Business, Part 2: Well-Armed and Dangerous|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}} features [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] as a participant in the [[attack on Praaelon Di]]. {{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=Bounty's Due}} depicts [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which includes the ''Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook'', to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Therefore, the rebellion on [[Weldii III]], which precipitated the attack on [[Praaelon Di]], according to {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}, must have occurred no later than in 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref>
